title: 905. Reverse Only Letters

examples.explanation: The letters reverse to d, c, b, a while the dash stays in place.
Reading the letters backwards gives j, I, h, g, f, E, d, C, b, a; dashes keep their spots.
Only English letters move; digits and punctuation never shift.

hints: Walk in from both ends, skipping anything that is not an English letter.
Whenever both pointers sit on letters, swap them and move inward.
Non-letters are never moved, so they automatically end up where they started.
